content: This seems out of order. "Turn off the printer and disconnect it from the power." should not come 2 steps before "Make sure firmware is up-to-date" and then "Home the bed".

I'm not sure why they want us to follow the MMU3 build guide backwards. It's a fair amount of work to figure out what to do along side what NOT to do. I feel like they could have just added a page or two of steps for us to follow instead.  Here's what I did for my MMU3 **Enclosed** version. It appears that the Lite version mounts differently (and more simply).

- Remove the top cover. 
- Unload any existing filament from the MMU3.
- Power off and unplug the printer.
- Remove all of the PTFE tubes from the back of the MMU3 by pushing in the collet and pulling the tubes out.
- Remove the buffer assembly from the CORE One.
- Remove the PTFE tube from the Nextruder and the MMU3.
- On the back of the MMU3 you will see a data cable that runs down and connects to the back of the CORE One. Remove the cable from the MMU3 by pressing the release tab and pull the cable straight out. You will remove the other end of the cable when the INDX instructions have you open up the back of the case.
- Remove the MMU3. There are 4 Torx screws to remove. Two in the back are threaded into the case itself. Two (one on each side) are held in place with nyloc nuts, so you will need a wrench to hold the nut in place while you unscrew the Torx screw. Once the screws are removed, you can lift the MMU3 off of the case.

I'm quoting this from memory having just completed it. So take that into consideration while following these steps.
